messages:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up: we still need a compact contract for annotating handoffs between hosted/dedicated/private. Goal: surface routing origin and degradation without blowing up metric cardinality. Sketch below.

trina: Sounds good. Key constraints: metrics = finite enums only; traces can be richer but only sampled and permissioned.

sam: Proposed minimal tags: hosting=HOSTED|DEDICATED|PRIVATE; path=PREFERRED|FALLBACK|DEGRADED; bucket=perf|balanced|accurate|other; fallback=none|capacity|compat|auth|quota; route_ver=short token (v1,v2). Keep everything low-cardinality.

alex: Implementation idea: propagate via lightweight headers at first runtime hop. Example header set:
X-RW-Hosting: DEDICATED
X-RW-Path: FALLBACK
X-RW-Bucket: perf
X-RW-Route-Ver: v2
X-RW-Fallback: capacity
X-RW-Telemetry-Sample: 1/500
Headers are advisory for exporters; runtime/adapters can override as they hand off.

hari (sec): Important: never ship tenant identifiers or raw model names into hosted metrics. Private deployments may opt into higher-cardinality tags but only into their own pipelines/audit sinks. Any trace payloads with sensitive content must be explicitly opt-in and access-controlled.

trina: To avoid model-name cardinality, runtime keeps a small mapping table model_name -> bucket. New models default to "other" and trigger an ops annotation. Exporter should canonicalize unexpected tag values to "other" and emit an alert.

sam: Edge case: multi-hop handoffs (hosted -> dedicated -> private). Precedence rules: hosting = first non-UNKNOWN value; path = most_degraded seen (if any stage used FALLBACK or DEGRADed mark that). That prevents double-counting.

alex: Also propose a light reason_code header for short vetted codes (e.g., PINNED, EXP_QAT) that do NOT surface in metrics but can be looked up in the control plane for debugging. Reason codes must be created via admin flow and reviewed by security.

hari (sec): +1 on reason_code with vetting. Ensure lookup service returns descriptions only to authorized users and that descriptions cannot contain tenant PII. Add TTL for sampled traces (30d) and a retention-exception workflow.

trina: Migration plan: 1) runtime emits defaults (UNKNOWN,PREFERRED,balanced,none,Reason=NONE). 2) adapters override headers when they make decisions. 3) exporter normalizes tags and maps unknowns to "other". 4) dashboards switch to redwood.request.latency_ms{hosting,path,bucket}. 5) deprecate dashboards that rely on raw model names.

sam: I'll implement header emission + mapping table API. ops-bot: please ping for the next small runtime deploy.

ops-bot: Next runtime deploy window Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Tag @sam to reserve. :calendar:

alex: Action items: alex update RFC with header examples + reason_code catalog; sam PR + tests; hari draft telemetry policy text; trina design mapping + exporter normalization. I'll post updated RFC patch tomorrow.
